---
title: Interactive Rmd
output: html_document
runtime: shiny
---
  
```{r, echo = FALSE}
#first chunk is called a "widget". Interactive interface.
numericInput("n",
"How many cars?", 5)

#second chunk is the code looking for interface and runs/generates output."Renderer"
renderTable({
head(cars, input$n) # input$ looks for name of widget created in prior code chunk.
})
```
